hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Claude needs input" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null || notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Claude needs input' 2>/dev/null || true
osascript -e 'display notification "Task completed" with title "Claude Code"' 2>/dev/null || notify-send 'Claude Code' 'Task completed' 2>/dev/null || true

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$branch" ] && branch="no-git"; cw=$(echo "$input" | jq '.context_window'); if [ "$cw" != "null" ]; then usage=$(echo "$cw" | jq '.current_usage'); current=$(echo "$usage" | jq '(.input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0)'); if [ "$current" = "0" ] || [ -z "$current" ]; then current=$(echo "$cw" | jq '.total_input_tokens // 0'); fi; size=$(echo "$cw" | jq '.context_window_size // 200000'); pct=$((current * 100 / size)); if [ $pct -eq 0 ]; then context_info="—"; elif [ $pct -lt 40 ]; then context_info=$(printf '\033[32m%s%%\033[0m' "$pct"); elif [ $pct -lt 80 ]; then context_info=$(printf '\033[33m%s%%\033[0m' "$pct"); else context_info=$(printf '\033[31m%s%%\033[0m' "$pct"); fi; else context_info="—"; fi; printf '%s | %s | %s' "$dir" "$branch" "$context_info"
